 env values differ. This module hosts that body once so per-package

-The stability-class reset is required because
-``_OpenTelemetrySemanticConventionStability`` caches the first read of

+The stability-class reset is kept as test-isolation hygiene:

replies.body: You're right — `instrument()` doesn't set `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN` at all anymore, so there's nothing left for the reset to protect against here. Removed it (and the now-unused import) in the latest commit.

In the current util implementation, the value must match the `ContentCapturingMode` enum names (e.g. `span_only`), so `true` is not valid and the semconv env-var note is stale. Also fix the typo “attibutes”.
